base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from JD's interim release (20-F/6-K filer, no EDGAR 10-Q): OCF RMB 51,117M (FY25 18,991 - H1'25 6,147 + H1'26 38,273; ties to reported TTM OCF) - total capex RMB 17,963M - SBC RMB 4,282M (FY25 4,727 - H1'25 2,424 + H1'26 1,979) = RMB 28,872M = US$4,255M / 2,841M diluted ordinary shares = $1.498/ordinary share = $3.00 per ADS (1 ADS = 2 ordinary shares; engine run per ordinary share at --price 13.38, IVs doubled back to per-ADS)
moat_justification: Owned logistics network and 1P supply-chain scale drive record JD Retail margins (gross margin up 17 straight quarters), but consumers multi-home across Alibaba/PDD/Douyin with ~zero switching costs, food delivery is a cash-burning #3 position vs Meituan, group margins are structurally thin, and China regulatory overhang is recurring (RMB 635M SAMR fine in H1 2026).
name: JD.com, Inc.
one_liner: China's strongest logistics/supply-chain retailer, moat 5/10, core at record margins while management spends group profit on the food-delivery war - on recovered TTM owner's earnings ($3.00/ADS) it clears 15% (weighted IRR 18.0%, IV@15% $33.83 vs $26.76), with a real margin of safety at ~$25.40 or below.
